mentions.name: kyoubenkyou
mentions.description: Japanese language learning web app with a JA->EN dictionary, hiragana/katakana/time/number reading quizzers, anki-style kanji study using FSRS, and a vocab quizzer. Its reader feature lets learners upload Japanese texts (light novels, children's books) to practice translation and reading comprehension, with cursor-based dictionary lookup on any selected text and LLM evaluation of translation accuracy (0-100%) plus suggested alternative interpretations. Built with Elixir, LiveView, Postgres, and pgroonga.
